description: This file declares functions and includes relevant headers for patching a Realtek RTL826XB PHY device. It provides interface functions for applying patches to individual or broadcast PHY ports and initializing related patch data.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to a specific PHY port based on unit, base port, and port offset.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_broadcast_patch
methods.description: Apply patch data to multiple PHY ports in broadcast mode, with options for per-chip or per-bus modes.

methods.name: phy_rtl826xb_patch_db_init
methods.description: Initialize the PHY patch database for a specific port and unit.
